title: Eval-Awareness Cues: Replicate the Detection Trigger Across Prompt Phrasings

original_idea.body: # Eval-Awareness Cues. Systematically vary surface cues in a scheming scenario and measure how each changes eval-awareness verbalization rate across open models; identify the most potent cues.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Finding awareness cues improves eval validity; clear chain to trustworthy safety evals.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Systematic cue ablation via prompting + CoT counting; accessible to beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused cue-variation study; multiple cues x models adds modest breadth.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Eval-design infrastructure with open models; labs underweight.

novelty.reasoning: Eval-awareness studied; systematic cue-attribution across open models plausibly open.
